all.name: Comprehensive Overview

all.tagline: Combines mechanical engineering principles with modern programming capabilities to direct $22M in capital/maintenance budgets, manage 3 production shops, and drive operational excellence.
all.summary: Results-driven Mechanical Engineer with experience directing heavy industrial manufacturing facilities. In charge of 3 plant shops (Machine, Drum, Fabrication) with direct oversight of an $22M budget portfolio ($12M CapEx, $8M maintenance parts & labor, $2M continuous improvement). Focused on optimizing equipment reliability while working with maintenance & operations to ensure all teams are satisfied with results, mentor incoming engineers, and deliver high-stakes capital modernizations on schedule without compromising installation integrity.

management.tagline: Directing an $22M portfolio ($12M CapEx, $8M maintenance parts & labor, $2M CI), overseeing 3 manufacturing shops, and mentoring new and existing engineering teams.
management.summary: Engineering leader with proven operational ownership across 3 plant shops (Machine Shop, Drum Shop, Fabrication Shop) and direct stewardship of an $22M financial portfolio ($12M in capital execution, $8M in maintenance parts/labor, and $2M in continuous improvement). systems.name: Systems Engineering

systems.tagline: Designing safe, high-reliability mechanical, electrical, and tooling systems through root-cause failure analysis and optimizations for reliability & maintainability.
systems.summary: Systems engineer with deep background spanning high-stakes nuclear facilities (Savannah River Nuclear Solutions) and heavy continuous manufacturing (Bridgestone). Great at leading teams and changing culture to a positive atmosphere that has a 'will get it done' attitude. Skilled in modeling, root cause failure analysis, and translating complex requirements into reliable plant systems with lower cost and simple, maintainable solutions.

datacenter.summary: Mechanical and systems engineer specializing in 24/7 mission-critical uptime, industrial heat transfer systems, and facility reliability. Serves as 24/7 on-call technical authority for plant mechanical systems, directing an $8M maintenance parts and labor budget to maximize equipment availability. Combines hands-on floor collaboration with technicians and trades, thermodynamic research at Savannah River Nuclear Solutions, and in-house fabrication support for rapid, permanent failure remediation.

summary: Results-driven Senior Mechanical Engineer with experience directing heavy industrial manufacturing facilities and nuclear operations. In charge of 3 plant shops (Machine, Drum, Fabrication) with direct stewardship of an $22M budget portfolio ($12M CapEx, $8M maintenance parts & labor, $2M continuous improvement). Grounded in servant leadership, active listening, and cross-functional team cohesion—bridging engineering, maintenance, and floor operations to solve complex failures, mentor incoming engineers, and deliver high-stakes capital modernizations on schedule without compromising installation integrity.

experience.overview: Directing engineering services, shop operations, and capital programs for global rubber mixing manufacturing operations at the Bridgestone Americas Aiken Off Road Radial Tire plant.

bullets.text: Promoted to Senior Mechanical Engineer in 2024 to direct operations across 3 manufacturing shops: Machine Shop, Drum Shop (specialized tire tooling), and Fabrication Shop.
Steward an $22M financial portfolio comprising $12M in capital expenditure (CapEx) execution, an $8M maintenance parts & labor budget, and $2M in plant continuous improvement initiatives.
Champion servant leadership by mentoring 4 engineering interns and actively seeking insights from machinists, certified welders, and floor technicians to solve chronic machine failures.

Cultivated a collaborative, positive team atmosphere across engineering, maintenance, and operations, building consensus on complex overhauls to ensure high installation integrity without schedule slip.
Modernized process equipment and tire-building drum tooling utilizing CNC machining, dynamic balancing, welding standards, and practical GD&T optimized for maintainability and reliability.
Optimized spare parts inventory and work-order management through SAP PM / CMMS, partnering closely with maintenance crews to reduce turnaround times and operational downtime.
Serve as 24/7 technical authority for high-stakes mechanical systems, leading cross-functional root-cause failure analysis (RCA) to deliver robust, simple, cost-effective engineering fixes.

experience.overview: Provided systems engineering for critical nuclear materials processing and facility operations.

bullets.text: Engineered safe mechanical system designs and standard operating procedures for critical nuclear materials processing facilities.
Researched industrial heat transfer systems and thermal efficiency opportunities to reduce facility energy consumption and operational costs.
Collaborated across multi-department teams to implement continuous improvement projects that reduced equipment maintenance downtime.
Provided humble, multi-discipline technical consultation—listening to diverse stakeholder concerns to translate complex nuclear requirements into practical, reliable systems.

education.degree: Bachelors of Science in Mechanical Engineering
education.details: 3.87 GPA · Magna Cum Laude honors · Focus on mechanical design, solid mechanics, thermal fluid systems, and manufacturing processes.

projects.title: 3 Production Shops & $22M Capital/Maintenance Stewardship
projects.summary: Directed 3 manufacturing shops (Machine, Drum, Fabrication), stewarded an $22M financial portfolio ($12M CapEx, $8M parts/labor, $2M CI), and mentored 4 engineering interns.
projects.description: Led operational and financial governance for critical manufacturing shops at Bridgestone Americas. Practiced servant leadership by working side-by-side with Machinists, Welders, and Fabricators to ensure practical maintainability, manage spare parts supply chains in SAP PM, and deliver capital modernizations with zero compromise on installation integrity.
highlights: In charge of Machine Shop, Drum Shop, and Fabrication Shop operations
Stewarded $12M CapEx execution, $8M maintenance parts/labor, and $2M continuous improvement
Supervised and mentored 4 engineering interns, fostering a supportive learning environment
Streamlined maintenance work-orders and spare parts inventory in SAP PM through crew collaboration

projects.title: Tire Building Drum & Tooling Modernization Program
projects.summary: Modernized heavy tire building drums, tooling, and fabrication workflows with CNC machining, precision balancing, and maintainability-focused GD&T standards.
projects.description: Engineered custom manufacturing tooling and managed rebuild/refurbishment workflows for high-value tire building drums. Listened closely to floor operators and technicians to identify real-world ergonomic and maintenance pain points, establishing dynamic balancing protocols and achievable precision machining tolerances.
highlights: Directed high-precision Drum Shop rebuilds and dynamic balancing procedures
Implemented practical GD&T tolerancing and dimensional inspection workflows
Partnered with certified welders and machinists to incorporate craft insights into tooling designs
Reduced drum turnaround time and eliminated recurring tooling defects

projects.title: Nuclear Facility Heat Transfer & Energy Optimization
projects.summary: Researched industrial heat transfer systems and energy recovery opportunities at Savannah River Nuclear Solutions to lower operational costs and improve thermal efficiency.
projects.description: Evaluated process heat transfer systems, thermodynamics, and energy utilization within high-stakes nuclear facilities. Modeled thermal efficiency gains, evaluated cooling fluid dynamics, and collaborated with multi-discipline engineering teams on continuous improvement initiatives.
highlights: Identified heat transfer optimization and facility energy savings opportunities
Ensured rigorous safe system designs and regulatory operating procedures
Engaged cross-department personnel with humility to ensure shared alignment on safety procedures
Formulated continuous improvement projects to reduce long-term maintenance downtime

projects.title: Cross-Functional Root Cause Analysis & 24/7 Plant Reliability
projects.summary: Served as primary 24/7 technical authority for high-stakes rubber mixing mechanical systems, solving complex failures by listening to operators and maintenance crews.
projects.description: Provided around-the-clock engineering support and technical ownership for high-throughput heavy manufacturing equipment. Led root-cause failure investigations with cross-functional teams—gathering frontline technician perspectives to uncover root causes and implement simple, permanent mechanical solutions.
highlights: Primary 24/7 technical expert for heavy mechanical systems and emergency troubleshooting
Led cross-functional RCA investigations with maintenance crew leaders and fabricators
Cultivated an open, blameless problem-solving culture focused on long-term equipment reliability
Developed predictive inspection procedures and updated technical engineering documentation

projects.title: Data Center & Critical Cooling Thermal Calculator
projects.summary: Interactive thermodynamics calculator estimating critical facility cooling airflow (CFM), heat rejection tonnage, and annual energy savings across varying PUE targets.
projects.description: An interactive engineering calculation tool implementing fundamental thermodynamics (Q = m * Cp * dT) to determine required cooling air delivery, sensible cooling tonnage, and energy savings for high-density IT and plant facilities.
highlights: Live calculation of CFM airflow, total heat rejection, and refrigeration tonnage
Dynamic PUE sensitivity modeling with energy cost savings projection
Demonstrates mechanical thermal fluid principles applied to mission-critical infrastructure

projects.title: Parametric CAD Assembly Viewer (3D WebGL)
projects.summary: Interactive 3D mechanical assembly viewer with real-time kinematic explode view, wireframe mode, and parametric component inspection.
projects.description: Showcases mechanical design principles directly in WebGL using Three.js. Features a pillow-block bearing and bracket assembly with multi-part hierarchy (base plate, upright walls, bearing sleeve, precision shaft, fastener hardware) and dynamic orbit/explode controls.
highlights: Hierarchical multi-part 3D CAD visualization in WebGL
Kinematic slider for explode-view assembly inspection
Demonstrates integration of mechanical engineering with interactive web technologies

projects.title: Euler-Bernoulli Beam Deflection Calculator
projects.summary: Closed-form Euler-Bernoulli beam solver calculating maximum deflection, bending stress, and moment distributions under various support and loading conditions.
projects.description: Computes exact closed-form solutions for beam deflection under point and distributed loads for both simply-supported and cantilever configurations. Features real-time elastic curve rendering, section modulus calculation, and material modulus selection.
highlights: Rigorous closed-form structural mechanics formulas without external blackbox libraries
Real-time canvas rendering of beam deformation curve and support reactions
Computes peak fiber bending stress and compares against material limits

projects.title: Software Engineering, Automations & Web Tools
projects.summary: Engineered software automations and web tools to support cross-team communication, equipment tracking, and operational workflows.
projects.description: Combines mechanical engineering depth with programming capabilities. Developed custom automation scripts and web tools for engineering calculations, automated reporting, data visualization, and plant communication.
highlights: Built responsive web applications and automated data collection pipelines
Bridged physical plant hardware and enterprise data systems
Created tools to empower operations and maintenance teams with clear data
